claims.text: What the scan is Technetium-99m bound to diphosphonate images the skeleton, to look for bone metastasis or infection
claims.quote: For imaging the skeleton, technetium-99m is combined with diphosphonate and used to check for bone metastasis or infection.

claims.text: It images the whole skeleton at a relatively low radiation dose
claims.quote: it uses a relatively low dose of radiation and provides valuable information (eg, it enables clinicians to image the entire skeleton when they suspect cancer has metastasized to bone)

claims.text: Reading it Hot spots: multiple foci of increased uptake are consistent with metastases
claims.quote: Delayed whole-body technetium-99m bone scintigraphic image shows multiple foci of increased uptake consistent with metastatic disease.
claims.locator: Bone Scintigraphy of the Whole Body (image caption)

claims.text: Suspect metastases when there are multiple lesions; a single lesion in a patient with cancer may not be a metastasis
claims.quote: Metastases should be suspected in patients who have multiple lesions on bone scan or PET scan. Although metastases are suspected in patients with known cancer and a single bone lesion, the lesion may not be a metastasis

claims.text: Bone scan is more sensitive than radiographs for early, asymptomatic metastases
claims.quote: Bone scan or PET/CT is more sensitive for early and asymptomatic bone metastases than radiographs and can be used to scan the entire body.

claims.text: Limits Nonspecific: abnormal earlier than radiographs in osteomyelitis, but cannot tell infection from fracture or tumor
claims.quote: The bone scan shows abnormalities earlier than radiographs but does not distinguish between infection, fractures, and tumors

claims.text: Multiple myeloma: a bone scan does not reliably show the lesions
claims.quote: Unlike in metastatic disease, a radionuclide bone scan will not reliably show lesions
